use_cases: Primary navigation for SaaS and dashboard applications with collapsible sidebar support
Mobile-responsive navigation drawer with hamburger menu trigger
Admin panel navigation with active state indicators for current page
Space-efficient navigation using collapse functionality on desktop viewports
Multi-section app navigation with icons and labels for visual clarity
ai_summary: A responsive sidebar navigation component with dark gradient styling featuring a collapsible mode for desktop and hamburger-triggered drawer for mobile. Includes overlay backdrop on mobile, smooth CSS transitions, active item highlighting, and icon-based menu items. Built for SaaS applications, admin dashboards, and dev tool interfaces requiring persistent navigation with space-saving options.
